reviews.text: Amazing place for our dogs to enjoy the outdoors while we’re at work, it’s so reassuring knowing they’re running around in fields with all their doggy friends. Seb and the team are very experienced and take great care of Senna and Lilo. Highly recommend!

Couldn’t recommend RunaMutt more they have such an amazing facility and take such amazing care of our 7 month old Puppy Maple.

She comes back  happy and healthy every time! Thank you Seb and team.
We couldn’t recommend Runamutt enough. They take care of our little girl like she’s one of their own. Thank you to Seb and all the crew.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We honestly cannot recommend Runamutt Doggy Daycare highly enough. Seb and the whole team are absolutely fantastic and genuinely care about every dog that comes through the gates.

We have tried other doggy daycares in the area, but Runamutt is in a completely different league. The team are so personable, flexible, and professional, and you can tell immediately that they love what they do. They take the time to understand each dog’s personality and needs, and it feels like they treat them as part of the family rather than just another booking.

Cúán absolutely loves it there and always comes home happy, tired, and clearly very well looked after. It gives us total peace of mind knowing he’s in such safe and caring hands.

If you’re looking for a daycare where the people genuinely go above and beyond and where your dog will be properly cared for, Runamutt is the place. Couldn’t recommend them more.

I couldn’t recommend Runamutt any more! Seb and his team are so professional and take such great care of the dogs.
I have never seen a happier group of dogs than the ones at Runamutt.
Thank you for all the great work
Fantastic doggy daycare. Seb and his team clearly love all the pups in their care and the feeling is entirely mutual for our 1 year old Irish doodle. Can’t recommend highly enough.
We’ve been sending Ollie up for a few months now and he loves it! Jumps out of the car and doesn’t look back! Seb and the gang are great with the dogs!

Runamutt Doggy Daycare is amazing. It is very reasonably priced, flexible opening hours, great location and lots of space (indoors and outdoors) for the dogs to play and socialise. Seb is fantastic with all sizes / types of dogs, so patient and experienced with them all. We have two dogs (a puppy and a 5 year old) who have very different personalities. The 5 year old being a little fussy, set in her own ways and can make strange but within a few days at Runamuttdoggydaycare Seb fast became her favourite person and that remains 5 months later as evidenced by her dashing to get out the car first when I drop them in the mornings. Both dogs are so happy and tired (which is a big plus) in the evenings when they are at daycare! I can’t recommend Seb and his team more - a hidden gem for doggy daycare!
Seb is just brilliant! So friendly and easy going. My pup loves driving up to the gates every day.
A really great service by a lovely team.  Bran loves it and we are really lucky to have it nearby.  Highly recommend Runamutt!

Highly recommend Runamutt!
Gizmo is fearful of humans but Seb has fast become his favourite person!
The freedom the dogs have is amazing. The opening hours are so accommodating for people working… Myself and Gizmo cant say enough nice things :-)
